basic_info.description: This Elegant Marina style 2 unit building is located on a wonderful tree lined block in the Inner Sunset. Each flat has 2BRs with a sunroom (accessible through both bedrooms), a split bath, LR fireplaces and a stylish formal dining room. The sunrooms steps out on to a balcony and have closets. The upper flat features a stunning size LR with coved ceilings, beautiful detailed wood built in cabinets in LR & DR, LR fireplace, updated kitchen with pantry closet and breakfast area. The lower flat has a similar floor plan and features pretty inlay wood flooring, LR fireplace, coved ceilings, handsome built ins LR & DR cabinets, split baths, breakfast area and a sunroom murphy bed. Large garage has 2 cars side by side parking and storage rooms. The back stairs are newly built and the backyard is flat. Located in the vibrant Inner Sunset, there are plentiful restaurants, cafes, and shops. Iconic Golden Gate Park is a just a skip away and walking distance to UCSF's 'hospital of the future.' The building is so convenient to MUNI transportation including the N Judah downtown with a super 98 walkscore. All units are tenant occupied with current market rents.
